import shapely
import pytest
from shapely import wkt


def _is_ring_closed(coords):
    # coords is sequence of (x,y,...) tuples; closed if first equals last (2D compare)
    if len(coords) < 2:
        return False
    return coords[0][:2] == coords[-1][:2]


def test_wkt_loads_polygon_fix_structure_default_strict():
    # Default behavior should remain strict and raise on invalid unclosed polygon
    with pytest.raises(shapely.GEOSException):
        wkt.loads("POLYGON ((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1))")


def test_wkt_loads_polygon_fix_structure_enabled():
    g = wkt.loads("POLYGON ((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1))", fix_structure=True)
    assert g.geom_type == "Polygon"
    ext = g.exterior
    coords = list(ext.coords)
    assert _is_ring_closed(coords)


def test_from_wkt_fix_structure_keyword_and_strict_alias():
    # strict=False should imply fix_structure=True
    g = shapely.from_wkt("POLYGON ((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1))", strict=False)
    assert g.geom_type == "Polygon"
    assert _is_ring_closed(list(g.exterior.coords))
    # conflicting keywords should raise
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        shapely.from_wkt("POINT (0 0)", fix_structure=True, strict=True)


def test_wkt_loads_geometrycollection_fix_structure_enabled():
    gc = wkt.loads(
        "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION (POINT (0 0), POLYGON ((0 0, 1 0, 1 1, 0 1)))",
        fix_structure=True,
    )
    assert gc.geom_type == "GeometryCollection"
    assert len(gc.geoms) == 2
    poly = [g for g in gc.geoms if g.geom_type == "Polygon"][0]
    assert _is_ring_closed(list(poly.exterior.coords))
